name: Consentmo
summary: Shopify consent app that geolocates the visitor and shows the right GDPR, CCPA, PIPEDA or LGPD banner, with Google Consent Mode v2 and Meta, Microsoft and TikTok signals, cookie scanning and data-request pages — plus an accessibility widget and scanner from the Plus tier. Banner impressions are unlimited on every tier.
best_for: Shopify merchants selling into several jurisdictions who want one app to carry the cookie banner, the consent signals the ad platforms now demand, and a first layer of accessibility — and who go in knowing that the region-aware banner and the accessibility tools sit on the $37 tier.
skip_if: you sell outside Shopify; you need one plain cookie banner in one country, which the free tier or your theme already covers; or you need an actual accessibility audit and repair of your theme rather than a widget and a scanner.
honest_knock: Read the ladder before you budget $10 for this. The two things the listing leads with — web accessibility and a smart region-specific banner — are not on Standard; they start at Plus, $37 a month, which is 3.7 times the entry price. A Shopify Plus store that wants a banner on the checkout needs Enterprise at $64, and so does anything headless or on Hydrogen. The accessibility side is a widget and a scanner: it overlays controls and flags issues, but it does not change the theme markup underneath, which is where an accessibility audit actually looks — treat it as a first layer, not as a remediation. And the free tier puts Consentmo's own branding on the banner your visitors see first.

pricing.plans_source: hand-curated from the vendor's pricing page
pricing.notes: (read 2026-09-08 on apps.shopify.com/gdpr-backpack and on the vendor's own consentmo.com/pricing, which list the same four tiers) Billed in USD every 30 days, with a 7-day free trial on each paid tier. Banner impressions are unlimited on every tier, the free one included, so the ladder gates features rather than traffic. Free costs nothing and covers the cookie banner and preferences, the data-request and Do-Not-Sell pages, one banner language and one cookie scan a month, with minimal Consentmo branding on the banner. Standard is $10 a month or $100 a year (17% off) and adds unlimited cookie scans, multi-region compliance (GDPR, CCPA, PIPEDA and others), Google Consent Mode v2 and Meta, Microsoft and TikTok integrations, US opt-out signals, script blocking, multilingual banners with automatic detection, automatic Google Drive backups and removal of the branding. Plus is $37 or $370 a year and is where the accessibility side starts: web accessibility (ADA/WCAG), smart geotargeting, the EU withdrawal page for Directive 2023/2673, automated monitoring, scheduled scans, AI cookie categorisation, advanced analytics and full CSS customisation. Enterprise is $64 or $640 a year for IAB TCF 2.3, cross-domain consent sharing, a checkout banner for Shopify Plus, Hydrogen and headless support, A/B testing, an alt-text manager, bot and crawler protection and priority support.

free_plan_evidence: And the free tier puts Consentmo's own branding on the banner your visitors see first.

compare_with.name: accessiBe
compare_with.why: these two only look alike on the accessibility line. accessiBe sells accessibility as its whole product, on any site, and goes deeper than a widget; Consentmo sells consent as its whole product and adds accessibility from the $37 tier up. So if accessibility is the reason you are shopping, Consentmo's Plus tier is a starting layer rather than a replacement. If consent is the reason, the two are not in the same market at all: the cookie banner, the geotargeting and the Consent Mode integrations are what Consentmo is for, and they are not what accessiBe sells
